activity.description:
Defines whether an employee that requests time off would have the leave defined as:
  • `paidTimeoff ` (Not working, paid): typically for paid vacation, paid sick, and parental leave.
  • `unpaidTimeoff` (Not working, unpaid): typically for when an employees has used all of their paid time off balance, but still needs to take time off.
  • `workTime ` (Working): typically for working from home (WFH) or business travel.
To learn more, see Time off policy type settings.

employees.description: All employees matching the search request and service user scope for this call.

avatar.description: Image URL of the employee's avatar.

hobbies.description: A list of the employee's hobbies.

avatarUrl.description: The URL of the source of the avatar image.

companyId.description: The ID of the employee's company.

coverImageUrl.description: The URL of the cover image.

creationDateTime.description: The full timestamp of creation of the Employee.

displayName.description: Employee's display name. This defaults to first name & last name but can be customized.

fullName.description: The full name of the Employee (first name + surname).

id.description: A unique identifier representing a specific employee.

activeEffectiveDate.description: The active effective date the employee started to work

daysOfPreviousService.description: The number of days in previous service

department.description: The department this employee belong to.

durationOfEmployment.description: The tenure duration of the employee.

manager.description: The full name of the employee's manager.

originalStartDate.description: The original date the employee started to work

reportsTo.description: The full name of the person the employee reports to.

reportsToIdInCompany.description: The ID in company of the manager.

secondLevelManager.description: The full name of the manager in the second level

shortStartDate.description: The employee's employment start date without the year

siteID.description: The ID of the site the employee belongs to.

startDate.description: The employee's employment start date without the year

tenureDuration.description: The tenure duration of the employee.

yearsOfService.description: The number of years in service

description: Read employee profiles, histories, time off and tasks; create and update employees in HiBob.

hibob_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs when new employee is observed in HiBob. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

hibob_new_or_updated_employee_trigger.description: Runs when new or updated employee is observed in HiBob. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

hibob_new_or_updated_task_trigger.description: Runs when new or updated task is observed in HiBob. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

hibob_new_task_trigger.description: Runs when new task is observed in HiBob. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
